remarks: Fourth floor studio suite offers a queen bed, queen sofa bed, fireplace, full kitchen and full bathroom. Owner amenities include underground parking while lodging overnight, valet parking, discounts on golf and skiing, private owner locker rooms, private owner's lounge, year 'round access to the indoor/outdoor heated pool and hot tubs, and about 10-11 weeks per year on a rotating schedule with opportunities to stay during weeks you do not own. Ellicottville living and owning at a fraction of the cost!
